purpose: Non-admission source candidates for independent European windstorm event-loss and damage-function validation, with strict observational versus modelled and licensing boundaries.

entries.name: HANZE European Windstorm Impact Database v1.0 (1950-2020)
entries.provider: University of Szczecin researchers for European Commission JRC; Zenodo record 15266959
entries.spatial_scope: Europe, country-identified records with NUTS2 and occasional NUTS3 affected-region strings; affected regions are not asset coordinates or insured exposure footprints
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Original single XLSX 292136 bytes; complete response reassembled via 8 verified HTTP byte-range reads; source-published MD5 0a523543adf76003916186623812ab74 independently matched; computed SHA256 c2fe636c9e7a1e601d64f00f5bdef8fdf9aaa854060f4d5edcd02e1405140944; spreadsheet preview exposes 20 event/country/geographic/loss/source fields.
entries.note: 2026-11-05 ORIGINAL XLSX BYTE IDENTITY: all 292136 original bytes were reconstructed in memory using 8 server range reads; ZIP header present; MD5 independently recomputed exactly matched Zenodo's published 0a523543adf76003916186623812ab74; independent full-source SHA256 c2fe636c9e7a1e601d64f00f5bdef8fdf9aaa854060f4d5edcd02e1405140944. Raw workbook not placed in Git. Only a truncated parsed workbook view and country-specific Kyrill examples were reviewed, not full column/row scientific validation. Official Zenodo API metadata declares CC BY 4.0 and open access, but companion site states research purposes only and material derives partly from EM-DAT, Copernicus and national/insurance sources; redistribution and upstream rights still need review. Some Kyrill country rows explicitly state modelled economic loss from CDS, therefore NOT an independent C3S/CLIMK validation holdout. Country rows for one named storm are not independent physical occurrences; null monetary fields are not zero. 2020 EUR millions means economic impacts, NOT insurer claims, property rebuild cost, real insurer gross/net or AEP/OEP.

entries.name: Norwegian 1985-2020 municipality-level insured wind-damage study
entries.provider: Jaison, Sorteberg, Michel and Breivik; Norwegian Natural Perils Pool; NHESS 2024
entries.spatial_scope: Norway, 356 municipalities in the authors' harmonized study; not individual geocoded insured properties
entries.temporal_scope: 1985-2020 daily insurance counts and amounts, paper published 2024-04-23
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Published study compares daily municipality claims and losses with NORA3 winds and four damage functions; article, figures and supplements publicly accessible, but original daily insurance claim dataset is explicitly proprietary and unavailable for download
entries.note: Article data-availability paragraph explicitly says the daily insurance data cannot be shared; the paper CC BY 4.0 is NOT a licence to reproduce proprietary Norwegian claims. NORA3 winds are publicly available and Finance Norway NASK provides some public statistics, but neither automatically recreates the 356-municipality daily 36-year time series. Strong independent published validation methodology and zero-inflation finding only until a separately authorized source-level aggregate or data-use agreement is verified.
